definitions.gloss: washing rice; rinsing rice before cooking
definitions.explanation: The process of rinsing raw rice with water to remove starch and impurities before cooking. A fundamental step in preparing Japanese rice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{炊飯|すいはん}→炊飯：13377_suihan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{洗米|せんまい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To wash the rice before cooking.

examples.japanese: {洗米|せんまい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{透明|とうめい}→透明：04565_toumei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧。
examples.english: Repeat the rice washing until the water becomes clear.

examples.japanese: ⟦{無洗米|むせんまい}→無洗米：28489_musenmai⟧なら{洗米|せんまい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手間|てま}→手間：03554_tema⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{省|はぶ}けて→省く：02398_habuku⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ。
examples.english: No-wash rice is convenient because it saves you the trouble of washing.

notes:
Composed of {洗|せん} (wash) + {米|まい} (rice). Refers specifically to the rinsing of uncooked rice. The everyday expression is ⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{研|と}ぐ→研ぐ：04377_togu⟧ or ⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗|あら}う→洗う：00827_arau⟧, while {洗米|せんまい} is the more formal or technical term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {洗米|せんまい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to wash rice)
- {洗米|せんまい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{回数|かいすう}→回数：00139_kaisuu⟧ (number of rice-washing rinses)
- ⟦{無洗米|むせんまい}→無洗米：28489_musenmai⟧ (no-wash rice, pre-rinsed rice)
- {洗米|せんまい}⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{水|みず}に{浸|ひた}す→水に浸す：22277_mizunihitasu⟧ (to soak in water after washing)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{研|と}ぐ→研ぐ：04377_togu⟧ — to wash/polish rice; the everyday kitchen expression
- ⟦{無洗米|むせんまい}→無洗米：28489_musenmai⟧ — no-wash rice; rice that has been pre-processed to remove the bran layer
- ⟦{炊飯|すいはん}→炊飯：13377_suihan⟧ — rice cooking; the step that follows {洗米|せんまい}

USAGE:
{洗米|せんまい} appears on rice packaging instructions, in recipe books, and in food industry contexts. In casual conversation, ⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{研|と}ぐ→研ぐ：04377_togu⟧ is more natural. ⟦{無洗米|むせんまい}→無洗米：28489_musenmai⟧ (no-wash rice) has become popular for its convenience and water-saving benefits.
